text: {"lessons":["I should judge each stock by its contribution to my overall portfolio, not by whether it is above or below my average cost.","Selling winners gave me satisfaction, but I should not lock in gains automatically; I should keep or sell based on the investment plan, not the pleasure or pain of realizing a result.","A few months of price changes do not predict what comes next, so I should avoid reacting to short-term moves and trade only when a deliberate review supports it."]}
